description: Bayernwerk - Hochspannung - 110 kV is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The map shows the high-voltage grid of Bayernwerk Netz GmbH, covering the supply area of Bayernwerk Netz GmbH in the state of Bavaria. High-voltage overhead lines and high-voltage cables of the voltage level 110 kV as well as substations are shown. The cables are shown with an offset and are therefore not positionally accurate. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Bayernwerk - High voltage - 110 kV" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Strom, Hochspannungsnetz, Netzdaten, gdiby, Bayernwerk Netz GmbH. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
